scope: 隔离持久化、升级、备份恢复与真实进程重启验收

assertions.name: recoverable backups rejects nested destinations reached through a parent symlink before staging data
recoverable backups rejects a destination nested inside media before copying recursively
recoverable backups publishes only one of two simultaneous restores to the same destination
recoverable backups rejects equal-length corrupted originals and leaves no restored directory
recoverable backups detects modified encryption keys before publishing a restored copy
recoverable backups rejects corrupted source media instead of declaring a successful backup
recoverable backups never creates a missing source database as a side effect of backing up
recoverable backups writes a checksum manifest and restores the same source bytes
recoverable backups still restores legacy backups and verifies their original asset digest
recoverable backups refuses symlinks in source media
preserves existing billing modes and payment holds while upgrading the configured concurrency boundary
serializes simultaneous API/worker migrations on the same SQLite database
upgrades a populated 0039 backup and preserves new knowledge, planner revisions and media through restore and real API/worker restarts
does not publish a backup whose copied in-flight cache has disappeared
restores a complete online backup into a new installation and completes cached work without touching its source
reproduces a stalled restored cache, then recovers its copied bytes without any new provider submission
rebases legacy array manifests to the final destination while preserving status and source metadata
never falls back to an existing original-installation file if the copied cache is missing
rejects invalid ownership before updating any cache references
rejects invalid symlink before updating any cache references
rejects invalid bytes before updating any cache references
rejects invalid state before updating any cache references
rejects invalid format before updating any cache references
leaves cleared successful tasks and pathless text results unchanged

checks: 只用临时SQLite和合成PNG；测试环境拒绝dotenv与继承应用凭据；未读取或修改正式运行库。
从截至0039的38份迁移建立含账户、会话、项目、品牌、素材及旧创作快照的数据库，保持连接开启时执行在线备份。
恢复旧版备份后追加0040和0041，执行两次迁移；旧表全部记录与原迁移校验和保持一致，旧创作快照仅新增planner_revision=null。
新资料、回收产品、私人记忆、带来源和规划配置摘要的新快照在线备份，再恢复到另一目录。
原安装与中间升级安装目录删除后，恢复副本可解密合成供应商配置；原会话仍可访问原业务数据。
直接启动真实API与worker入口，连续完成两轮启动/正常停止；测试注入只观察SQLite真实database_list并禁止子进程外部fetch。
两进程每轮均验证实际打开的数据库为恢复目录；旧/新方案、记忆、产品、品牌和项目经HTTP读取成功；原图逐字节一致，预览及缩略图可解码。
两轮重启后创作快照完全不变、无生成任务、外键检查为空、数据库完整性为ok；两份源备份所有摘要始终不变。
已有回归另覆盖坏原件/大小/密钥、符号链接、并发目标发布、在途缓存路径重定位及零外部重新提交。
changes: 只新增 platform/tests/persistence-upgrade.test.ts；未修改产品、迁移或备份恢复实现。
limits: 未对正式运行库应用迁移或重启正式服务。
未验证外部模型、真实支付或通知投递；无付费调用。
本项验收直接运行TypeScript入口；生产构建与全量浏览器由主任务另行汇总。
